newsitem.title: CANADA: Tecmar plans subsidiary spin-off, TSE says.
newsitem.headline: Tecmar plans subsidiary spin-off, TSE says.

text.p: Tecmar Technologies Inc has announced a proposed spin-off of wholly-owned subsidiary Storage One Inc to shareholders, the Toronto Stock Exchange said in a statement on Friday.
A record date for the spin-off has not been announced, and the shares of Storage One will not be tradeable until Tecmar begins trading on an "ex-distribution" basis, the TSE said.
Short sales of Tecmar also are prohibited until further notice, the TSE said.
